synopsis: A man pours dark coffee from his mug only to watch the liquid stream defy gravity and flow upward in a perfect vertical line.
narration: Pouring my first cup this morning and the coffee literally went straight up. My roommate thinks it's some kind of magnet trick. What do you think?

shots.prompt: A matte black ceramic coffee mug with a thick handle and a slightly chipped rim. a smooth vertical column of dark coffee rising in one unbroken glossy stream with a rounded leading edge. The frame remains completely locked in a close-up profile view of the kitchen counter. A lived-in home kitchen counter: dark speckled stone-look surface with faint scratches and a few crumbs near the edge, a tiled backsplash behind, and morning daylight from a side window mixing with a warm under-cabinet glow. Hands wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt tilt the matte black mug filled with dark coffee. The dark liquid streams out of the mug, curving upward into the air toward the top of the frame.
shots.violation_observation: the coffee stream leaves the tilted mug and climbs upward through the air
